history.summary: A freehold 1,012 sqft 2BR in D15 at $2.69M / $2,656 PSF, 200m from Katong Park MRT (TEL). The transit and tenure are genuine assets and resale appreciation prints 7.5%/yr, but the $2.69M quantum sits well above the deep 2BR liquidity band and PSF is ~1.7% over the URA median.
history.rating_rationale: $2.69M is steep for a 2BR — above the $1.8M-2.5M sweet spot, so the buyer pool thins to investors/right-sizers. $2,656 PSF is slightly over the $2,612 median (no entry discount). The 7.54% CAGR rests on 25 txns (moderately reliable) and the 200m TEL station is a real catalyst, but the price/quantum offsets these. Low technical score (491).
red_flags: $2.69M quantum is above the deep 2BR liquidity band — narrower exit pool
PSF $2,656 sits ~1.7% above the $2,612 URA median, no entry margin

Freehold tenure in established D15 East Coast lifestyle district
